text_block_list.text:
It's time for Академия Тайсен's yearly
summer
camp. Симболи Рудольф stays
behind until the last
minute conducting
final checks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite the time crunch, she's totally
unhurried,
and she makes it in perfect
time for the summer
camp's official
opening with a little help from

Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
